metric_context.metric: distance-weighted Tversky index, alpha=0.2 beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel
metric_context.what_0.3195_requires: at ~40k dots, weighted recall of the hidden truth must rise from ~0.39 to ~0.52 (+24% credited mass) or dot count must fall to ~25k at equal credit; both are ranking/detection problems, not packing problems (GEMSDOE28 knowledge/01)

ranking_rule: expected incremental DTI per engineering cost, risk-adjusted; ranges are subjective priors that include zero; a candidate must pass the frozen P1/P2 proxy gate (evidence/holdout33.json protocol) before any weekly slot

hypotheses.name: Stepover relay-bridge faults between distinct mapped structures
layers: INGENIOUS Quaternary fault vectors (NBMG/USGS regional compilation; jklinck mirror of faults_quaternary_regional.shp, NAD83, validated 42.5% vertex proximity to supplied catalogue)
training band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg (>= in-footprint 80th percentile within 200 m)
hypotheses.physical_signature: tip-to-tip approach of DISTINCT fault polylines (300-2500 m gap, strike difference <= 30 deg) defines a relay ramp; sparse 283 m-spaced bridge dots are emitted along the tip line only where an independent isostatic-gravity horizontal-gradient edge passes within 200 m
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: stepovers, terminations and intersections of mapped faults concentrate unmapped synthetic/antithetic strands and blind tips (Faulds & Hinz 2015, OSTI 1110517; Desert Peak and Brady's geothermal fields are both hosted in fault step-overs). The supplied catalogue lists the major strands, not the relay-ramp splays, so bridges target exactly the omission class the expert panel labelled
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: GEMSDOE27's T-v2 filled gaps INSIDE the same polyline and failed live (0.00210 credit/dot vs 0.0495 break-even; 230/345 links were same-FID compiler artifacts). C2 is restricted to distinct-FID tip pairs and gated by a potential-field edge; it is an addition arm, validated before any slot
hypotheses.expected_live_delta: +0.000 to +0.002 (proxy-anchored judgment; proxies are not scores)

hypotheses.name: Analog-field ground-truth transfer with a measured domain-adaptation bound (Dixie Valley / Desert Peak / Brady's)
hypotheses.status: DESIGNED; external vectors availability-verified, bytes not yet restored in this sandbox
layers: Dixie Valley field fault map GIS_Faults.zip, GDR #207, DOI 10.15121/1148837 (Iovenitti; LiDAR + field-verified traces)
Desert Peak / Brady's detailed mapping, NBMG Open-File Report 03-27 (Faulds & Garside 2003)
GDR #1288 labelled training grids for Brady/Desert Peak, DOI 10.15121/1773692
shared feature layers: training_features.tif bands 1-19 resampled at each analog field
hypotheses.physical_signature: not a transform: a transfer protocol. Pretrain/co-train a fault detector on the analog field's denser, drilling-verified catalogue; measure source->target divergence on the shared GeoDAWN-type feature layers with a classifier-two-sample test (d_A-distance); where divergence is small, Ben-David et al. (2010, DOI 10.1007/s10994-009-5152-4) bound target error by source error plus divergence, licensing the analog geometries as a genuinely independent validation set never touched by the GeoDAWN catalogue
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: the analog fields were mapped by industry-funded fieldwork and dense drilling, so they contain verified fault geometries of the exact class (blind, buried, low-scarp strands) that a regional USGS/INGENIOUS compilation never captured in GeoDAWN; the transfer is bounded, not assumed
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: no GEMSDOE campaign has used off-region labelled faults; the repo's only labelled truth is the supplied catalogue (and proxies derived from it). H41 used slip-rate-weighted corridor columns of the SAME catalogue
hypotheses.expected_live_delta: +0.000 to +0.005 (ceiling set by divergence; unknown until measured)

hypotheses.name: Shallow thermal-probe residual lineaments x gravity edges
hypotheses.status: DESIGNED; inputs mirrored locally (runnable next session)
layers: INGENIOUS 2 m temperature probe archive (GEMSDOE24 mirror of 2m_temperature_probe_INGENIOUS_regional_data.zip; original at GDR #1391, CC BY 4.0)
training band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg and band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope
USGS Great Basin conductive heat-flow residual (DeAngelo et al. 2022, DOI 10.5066/P9BZPVUC) once fetched
hypotheses.physical_signature: aligned positive 2 m temperature residuals (probe kriging residual above the de-convected background) that co-align with a gravity-gradient edge; warm shallow ground along a buried structural conduit without a mapped scarp
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: fluid ascent along blind faults warms the shallow subsurface measurably at 2 m even where no Quaternary surface rupture exists; the catalogue needs surface evidence, the probe field does not
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: GEMSDOE28 H35-1 (spring/well discharge-point conjunction) FAILED its far-field gate below a matched random control; H33-B uses the spatially continuous 2 m probe field and a residual-above-background definition, not discharge points. GEMSDOE28 H38-2 queued this idea but never ran it (data gate)

hypotheses.name: Radiometric K-Th alteration halo corridors on gravity lineaments
hypotheses.status: PARTIALLY PRE-EMPTED (check GEMSDOE29 seeds 280-289 radiometric experiment before spending a slot)
layers: GeoDAWN radiometric K, eU, Th grids (GEMSDOE24 geodawn_rad_u8.tif mirror; native grids CC0 via USGS ScienceBase 657e1d85d34e23d3533209f7)
training bands 13/18 isostatic gravity anomaly and horizontal gradient
hypotheses.physical_signature: hydrothermal alteration destroys K-feldspar and redistributes K/Th (argillic leaching); K/eU and Th/K ratio lows elongated along an independent gravity lineament mark an altered fault conduit
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: alteration halos persist around old or buried conduits that lack any Quaternary surface rupture, i.e. the class the Quaternary-scope catalogue cannot list
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: GEMSDOE29 ran a GeoDAWN-radiometric arm on seeds 280-289 (its result record was not retrievable this session - flagged IR-EVIDENCE-01); H33-D must be reconciled against that record before execution

hypotheses.name: Expert-panel strategy: geologically defensible isolated traces for the Final Prize Round
layers: all corroborated candidate dots from C1/C2 plus SGMC off-catalogue fault pixels >= 300 m from the supplied catalogue
hypotheses.physical_signature: no transform: the Final Prize Round re-scores every submission against an EXPANDED label set built by an expert panel that reviews all submissions; well-localised, independently corroborated traces that experts accept become new truth
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: by construction it targets only features absent from the catalogue; its value is invisible to the Initial Round DTI, which is why it is carried as a parallel objective rather than a gated arm
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: GEMSDOE28 knowledge/01 notes the same incentive; no campaign has yet shipped a panel-oriented dossier file
hypotheses.expected_live_delta: Initial round: ~0 (or slightly negative); Final round: positive optionality
